ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Predominantly low-intensity dark pigment covering approximately 90% of the visible surface, with high-intensity white pixel clusters localized at the distal tips and trailing edge margins.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Large contiguous dark-grey central field; concentrated high-contrast white pixel blobs at the left and right distal tips; scattered high-intensity white circular points (scars) throughout the dark region.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep, sharp V-shaped central depression visible at the lobe intersection.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Right lobe trailing edge displays high-frequency, sharp sawtooth serrations; left lobe displays more irregular, medium-frequency peaks and shallower valleys.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Concave curvature along the trailing edge leading from the median notch to the distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Multiple circular and ring-shaped white pixel clusters scattered on the dark surface, including a prominent circular ring on the lower-center of the right lobe.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Short, unaligned white linear pixel disruptions (rake-like marks) visible on the dark pigmented sections of both lobes.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Localized clusters of white, textured calcified barnacle colonies at both distal tips; distinct white scarring patterns on the trailing edge margins.
other_distinctive_markers: Highly distinct white 'O' shaped circular ring on the right lobe surface pigment.
